title: Embedded Material (Print Only)

illustrates.quote: Embedded material refers to text inserted within a paragraph.

blocks.features: Boxed print-only mock-up: the identical sentence from Example 1-1 ('The fields are awash in a sea of blue.') is now run into the paragraph (italicised in the source image, not set off by blank lines or a different margin) -- illustrating 'embedded' material (BANA 1.4.6). No braille is given.

print.notes: Explicitly captioned '(Print Only)'; confirmed against the PDF page image (p.22).

resolution: Both runs agree: print-only, no braille. status: no-braille.
